description: Agent-first evaluations for the navigate skill: questions an agent must answer about symbol lookup, references, and definition resolution.

evaluations.question: Where is the symbol `ToolDescriptor` defined and what file holds it?
acceptable_answers: Defined in crates/cognicode-core/src/interface/catalog.rs; query_symbol_index returns the file path, go_to_definition confirms the location, get_symbol_code returns the byte source

evaluations.question: Who calls `load_tool_catalog`?
acceptable_answers: find_references returns the callers of load_tool_catalog across the workspace; the symbol must already be indexed (build_lightweight_index or build_graph first)
Callers include rmcp_adapter and the CLI capabilities command; check find_references after indexing

evaluations.question: Show me the body of `validate_skill_against_catalog`.
acceptable_answers: get_symbol_code returns the function source; the function lives in crates/cognicode-cli/src/skills.rs
Returns the byte source of the function from skills.rs

evaluations.question: What is the type-reference for `ToolDescriptor`?
acceptable_answers: get_type_references returns every place that names ToolDescriptor as a type (not a call site)
Returns the type-reference set for ToolDescriptor

evaluations.question: Navigate to the import graph of `cognicode-cli/src/skills.rs`.
acceptable_answers: get_per_file_graph on skills.rs returns the imports/exports for that file
Returns the per-file graph centred on skills.rs
